name: Mystic Forge
oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.
{T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
blocked_sentences: You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.

needs.what: a `colorless: true` key in the `affects_spells` filter of a cast_from_library_top static, so "colorless spells" can be matched against the top card (zero printed colours, 105.2c); the artifact half is then a second cast_from_library_top static with types ["Artifact"], or one filter using any_of over the two
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_library_top's affects_spells accepts only LIBRARY_TOP_CAST_FILTER_KEYS (SPELL_FILTER_KEYS minus controller, plus power/toughness), which has neither `colorless` nor `any_of`; `colors` is a membership test and cannot say zero colours, and `min_colors` only sets a floor. characteristics._matches_printed already reads `colorless` and `any_of`, so the change is admitting the key in the loader's vocabulary. Writing only the artifact half would drop colorless nonartifact spells (Eldrazi, Kozilek's Return-style colorless cards)
